Q: tabcontrol selectedindex changed event not getting fired C# A:

Get another way to rise a SelectedIndexChanged event.

  1. In Load form set a tabControl1.TabIndex = 0;

  2. Create event a tabControl1_TabIndexChanged and set into this event tabControl1.SelectedIndex = 10; // set index 10 for example, as non-existent page index

  3. It fire a tabControl1_SelectedIndexChanged event with a tabControl1.SelectedIndex=0

Q: How to check if a public go function/struct is not used outside of the package? A:

To find references of a struct or a function in golang, generally GoPLS (The language server of Golang) is used, so what you can do is write a python script to find all references for this model or various other programatically (as you stated ) and then if the reference count is 0 you are good to go !!!

Q: How to load the latest version of code from SVN server ignoring my local changes? A:

Perhaps you could try removing the files from your local repo and then svn update. (keep the files some other place - you can always merge then)

Q: How can I list all projects in the current solution dependent on a given NuGet package? A:

The nuget command why shows the entire dependency graph of a certain package. You can use this command with transitive dependencies as well.

Documentation

Example:

dotnet nuget why System.Net.Http
